title: Implement deterministic policy evaluator
businessObjective: Advance Phase 1 — Trusted control foundation through one bounded policy-engine outcome.
technicalObjective: Implement the bounded deterministic V2 policy evaluator in packages/policy-engine/ using internally loaded canonical authorities: schemas/authorization-policy-contract-v2.schema.json, schemas/evaluation-context.schema.json, schemas/evaluation-decision.schema.json, and policies/deterministic-authorization-policies-v2.json. V1 remains a separate static P1-004 contract and is not a runtime authority.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/policy-engine/src/evaluator.mjs evaluates request contexts against internally loaded schemas/authorization-policy-contract-v2.schema.json, schemas/evaluation-context.schema.json, schemas/evaluation-decision.schema.json, and policies/deterministic-authorization-policies-v2.json.
Fail-closed evaluation posture returns explicit deny for missing fields, bad types, unapproved actions, or confidential data classifications.
node tests/policy-engine/validate-deterministic-policy-evaluator.mjs systematically tests valid and negative evaluation context cases.
npm run verify:fast passes and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the policy-engine branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.
